title: From Head to Tail: LLM-Augmented Sequential Recommendation and Trade-off Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.31052v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recommender systems exhibit popularity bias, often under-serving long-tail and cold-start items with sparse interaction data. We propose a group-specific data augmentation approach that leverages LLMs to generate synthetic interactions, formulated as a constrained optimization problem, maximizing group-specific NDCG@20 and coverage while bounding overall NDCG@20 degradation within an acceptable threshold. Items are partitioned by interaction frequency to find the optimal augmentation strategy for each group. We further study combining the augmentation across groups simultaneously and find that while individual optimal strategies navigate the multi-group augmentation design, they are not simply additive. We further ablate on the LLM-based augmentation itself, comparing LLM scales, augmentation configuration under token constraints, finding that augmentation quality scales with contextual richness, albeit at a proportionally higher cost.

translated_title: 从头部到尾部：LLM增强的序列推荐与权衡优化
translated_abstract: 推荐系统存在流行度偏差，常常对交互数据稀疏的长尾项目和冷启动项目服务不足。我们提出了一种面向特定分组的数据增强方法，利用大语言模型（LLM）生成合成交互数据，并将其形式化为一个约束优化问题：在将整体NDCG@20的下降限制在可接受阈值内的同时，最大化各分组的NDCG@20和覆盖率。项目按交互频率进行划分，以找到每个分组的最佳增强策略。我们进一步研究了同时组合跨分组增强策略的效果，发现虽然单个最优策略可以指导多分组增强设计，但它们并非简单可加。我们还对基于LLM的增强本身进行了消融实验，比较了不同规模的LLM以及token约束下的增强配置，发现增强质量随上下文丰富度的提升而提升，但相应成本也成比例增加。
tldr: 该论文提出利用LLM生成分组特定的合成交互数据，将缓解推荐系统流行度偏差的问题形式化为约束优化，以提升长尾与冷启动项目表现，并发现多分组增强策略并非简单可加，且增强质量随上下文丰富度提高而提升但成本更高。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an LLM-based group-specific data augmentation approach formulated as constrained optimization to mitigate popularity bias and improve long-tail and cold-start recommendation, finding that multi-group augmentation strategies are not simply additive and augmentation quality scales with contextual richness at proportionally higher cost.
